notes.title: Hotfix 20241104
notes.content:
A small hotfix update:
* The interaction will always target the closest available actor.
* Fixed the interaction widget not appearing, or appearing only partially.
* Fixed invalid landscape shadows in the main menu.

notes.title: Hotfix 20241011
notes.content:
A small hotfix update:
* Fixed some checkpoint system bugs.
* Fixed the Waterball power level changing on its own in the second half of the demo.
